taxonomy.name: M-type K+ current with fixed (voltage-independent) time constant
taxonomy.description: Slow non-inactivating M-type K+ current (Kv7/KCNQ) with a single activation gate (p or w), Boltzmann steady-state p_inf/w_inf, and a voltage-independent fixed scalar time constant (tau drawn directly from a parameter, precomputed before the simulation loop). Reversal typically E_K = -107 mV (some variants use -77 or -90 mV). Provides spike-frequency adaptation.

taxonomy.name: M-type K+ current with voltage-dependent (bell-shaped) time constant
taxonomy.description: Slow non-inactivating M-type K+ current (Kv7/KCNQ) with a single activation gate (p or w), Boltzmann or alpha/beta steady-state, and a bell-shaped voltage-dependent time constant (Wang 1998 form, cosh form, or symmetric exponential alpha/beta). Reversal typically E_K = -107 mV. Provides genuine slow spike-frequency adaptation with voltage-dependent kinetics.

taxonomy.name: M-type K+ current + Persistent Na+ current (fixed tau for I_M)
taxonomy.description: Two-channel combination: primary slow non-inactivating M-type K+ current (I_M/IKm, single gate p or w, fixed scalar tau) paired with a secondary persistent Na+ current (I_NaP) with instantaneous Boltzmann activation (no state variable ODE). I_NaP provides subthreshold depolarizing drive; I_M provides spike-frequency adaptation. Reversal E_K (various) and E_Na = +53 mV.
example_phrases: M-type K+ current with fixed tau paired with INaP
tau_M fixed scalar, INaP no state variable

taxonomy.name: M-type K+ current + Persistent Na+ current (voltage-dependent tau for I_M)
taxonomy.description: Two-channel combination: primary slow non-inactivating M-type K+ current (I_M/IKm, single gate p or w, bell-shaped voltage-dependent tau) paired with a secondary persistent Na+ current (I_NaP) with instantaneous Boltzmann activation (no state variable ODE). I_NaP provides subthreshold depolarizing drive; I_M provides voltage-dependent slow adaptation.
example_phrases: M-type K+ with bell-shaped tau paired with INaP

taxonomy.name: M-type K+ current + HCN/Ih hyperpolarization-activated current (fixed tau for both)
taxonomy.description: Two-channel combination: primary slow non-inactivating M-type K+ current (I_M, single gate p or w, fixed scalar tau) paired with a secondary hyperpolarization-activated cation current (Ih/HCN, single gate r or q, inverted Boltzmann, fixed scalar tau). Reversal E_K (various) and E_h (mixed cation, ~-20 to -30 mV). E_K often corrected to -77 mV in these variants.
example_phrases: M-type K+ with fixed tau paired with HCN/Ih
inverted Boltzmann r_inf activates on hyperpolarization

taxonomy.name: M-type K+ current + HCN/Ih hyperpolarization-activated current (voltage-dependent tau for I_M)
taxonomy.description: Two-channel combination: primary slow non-inactivating M-type K+ current (I_M, single gate p or w, bell-shaped voltage-dependent tau) paired with a secondary hyperpolarization-activated cation current (Ih/HCN, single gate q or r, inverted Boltzmann, fixed or voltage-dependent tau). Reversal E_K and E_h (mixed cation).
example_phrases: M-type K+ with voltage-dependent tau paired with HCN/Ih
bell-shaped tau_p for IM, inverted Boltzmann for Ih
slow tau ~500 ms at half-activation for Ih

taxonomy.name: M-type K+ current + A-type transient K+ current
taxonomy.description: Two-channel combination: primary slow non-inactivating M-type K+ current (I_M/IKm, single gate p, voltage-dependent bell-shaped tau) paired with a secondary A-type transient K+ current (IA/Kv4) with instantaneous activation (a_inf, no ODE) and slow inactivation gate (b, fixed tau_b). Both channels use E_K = -107 mV. has_inactivation_gate=true for the pair due to IA inactivation gate b.
example_phrases: M-type K+ paired with A-type transient K+
slow inactivation gate b with fixed tau_b

taxonomy.name: M-type K+ current + Slow AHP-type K+ current
taxonomy.description: Two-channel combination: primary slow non-inactivating M-type K+ current (IKm, single gate p, voltage-dependent tau via alpha/beta) paired with a secondary slow AHP-type K+ current (IKs, single gate q, voltage-dependent tau via alpha/beta with slower kinetics). Both channels use E_K = -107 mV and alpha/beta exponential rate functions.
example_phrases: M-type K+ paired with slow AHP K+ current

taxonomy.name: M-type K+ current + Background ohmic K+ leak conductance
taxonomy.description: Two-channel combination: primary slow non-inactivating M-type K+ current (IKm, single gate p, voltage-dependent tau) paired with a secondary background ohmic K+ leak conductance (no gating variable, purely instantaneous). Both use E_K = -77 mV (corrected). The background K+ leak is not a gated channel but an additional ohmic term.
example_phrases: M-type K+ paired with ohmic background K+ leak
no gating variable for background K+

taxonomy.name: Base HH model only (no additional channels)
taxonomy.description: No additional ionic currents beyond the three base HH channels (fast Na+, delayed-rectifier K+, ohmic leak). Included as a sentinel class for completeness.

taxonomy.name: Unknown or unclassified channel combination
taxonomy.description: Channel descriptions that do not fit any of the identified families, or whose channel family cannot be determined from the available information.
